jsonld_raw.name: DESK 02
jsonld_raw.description:
Made of noble woods and Campaspero stone, both the board and the legs respond to a timeless and sophisticated style that integrates into all kinds of spaces. The soft lines highlight the richness of its texture. A millimetric variation between the structure of the board and the stone allow effortless movement of the materials. It has three drawers without rails to maintain the essence of the wood.

The wood is treated with a wax coat that ensures the look and texture is as respectful as possible to the original material. The structure of this piece is made from oak-veneered fir plywood with solid oak wood details. This provides firmness, which contrasts with the lightness of the rectangular finishes of the legs.

The wood changes over time becoming a unique piece. Subtle features such as open streaks or color variations that confirm its authenticity and beauty will appear over time.

The Campaspero stone is an unprocessed material, so each piece has a unique aesthetic and may vary in color.

Made in Spain.

We will contact you when we receive your order information to arrange the delivery details.
